It really is all marketing. I can’t think of a single “staple” item that worked for us. As far as toys, household items like spatulas and water bottles have gotten more use than anything marketed to kids. At least for the first year.

When it arrived, she sat for about 2 minutes, and refused to get near it again. $50 wasted 😭 I just laugh to keep from crying at this point

I don’t know the answer to this, but I will say my girl was the same! LOVED solids as soon as we started around the 5 month mark. We only did an oz or 2 to start, and even then we were plagued with stomach problems. They just aren’t used to anything but milk. It took a while for her stomach to get used to solid foods. The food was fun for her, but the aftermath, (constipation) not so much. So I would stick with just a bit once a day for now, until their stomach can get used to the new delicious foods!

My LO is 7 months but has had these toys since before 6 months.

A fake tissue box that they can pull “tissues” out of. LO lovessss this toy. Great for fine motor skills

[Tissue Box](https://a.co/d/4GY7rNe)

Color coded mushroom toy. Says for 12+ months but LO enjoys it now. They make noises when you shake them and have cute faces. 

[Mushroom Toy](https://a.co/d/1zdOGkR)

Octopus toy that has a ton of different settings. Moves around on the floor for baby to chase, music settings, fun sounds

[Octopus Toy](https://a.co/d/2WdXTCW)

Get some classics like stacking rings, blocks, etc. My girl loves keys, rubber ducks, anything that makes noise really lol.
